description: See which processes are occupying local ports, then copy details or free a port.
capability.untrusted: Listing ports is available. Stopping processes is disabled in Restricted Mode.
config.title: Port Occupancy
config.showUdp: Include UDP sockets in the port list.
config.showEstablished: Also show established TCP connections, not only listening ports.
config.groupBy: How to group entries in the Ports view.
config.refreshInterval: Auto-refresh interval in seconds. 0 means refresh only when you ask.
config.confirmKill: Ask before stopping a process that owns a port.
config.forceKill: Force-stop processes (SIGKILL on macOS/Linux, taskkill /F on Windows).
config.ignoredProcesses: Process names to hide from the list.
config.ignoredPorts: Port numbers to hide from the list.
config.showStatusBar: Show listening-port count in the status bar.

view.ports.name: Ports
